players.product: NovaSeq sequencing, BioInsight, and Billion Cell Atlas multi-omics data

quarterly_data.signal: Illumina's 10-K: backlog was $738 million as of December 28, 2025 versus $657 million as of December 29, 2024, consisting of orders believed to be firm as of the balance sheet date. Illumina expects 77% of the year-end backlog to be shipped in 2026, 13% in 2027 and the remainder thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $738 million (December 28, 2025) vs $657 million; 77% to ship in 2026, 13% in 2027

quarterly_data.signal: XBRL segment revenue: Sequencing revenue was $3.98B for fiscal year 2025 (2024-12-30 to 2025-12-28), -0.2% YoY vs $3.99B. The revenue-by-source table shows 2025 sequencing consumables of $2,939 million (vs $2,858 million) and sequencing instruments of $465 million (vs $484 million); total company revenue was $4,343 million versus $4,372 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Sequencing $3.98B (-0.2% YoY); sequencing consumables $2,939 million; sequencing instruments $465 million; total revenue $4,343 million

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration: Illumina had no customers that provided more than 10% of total consolidated revenue in 2025, 2024 and 2023. The 10-K notes that a portion of revenue is increasingly derived from a small number of large, centralized laboratory customers.
quarterly_data.figure: no customer above 10% of revenue in 2025, 2024 or 2023

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K capex: Illumina invested $148 million in capital expenditures in 2025, primarily for investments in facilities.
